items.title: Why Strategy (MSTR) Shares Are Trading Lower Today
items.summary: Shares of bitcoin development company Strategy (NASDAQ:MSTR) fell 3.5% in the afternoon session after index provider MSCI proposed removing the company from its Global Investable Market Indexes, compounding concerns over recent sales of its Bitcoin holdings and a broad slide in cryptocurrency prices.
